prompt: Photograph taken from very high above, camera pointing straight down at the ground, no horizon and no sky, the earth laid flat like a map in a tall vertical frame. One long pale concrete boundary wall crosses the whole frame from left edge to right edge just below the middle, ruler-straight and casting almost no shadow. Above the wall: a private gated compound of a dozen identical white flat-roofed villas set in a neat grid, each with its own rectangular swimming pool of bright turquoise water, clipped emerald lawns, a single curving driveway, no cars moving, no people anywhere, not a ripple on any pool. Below the wall, packed tight against its base without a single metre of gap: a crowded settlement of improvised shelters roofed in faded blue, grey and rust-coloured tarpaulin and corrugated sheet, narrow dirt lanes, washing strung between roofs, thin threads of grey smoke from cooking fires drifting sideways, people reduced to tiny specks of colour. Even, shadowless light from a thick white overcast, everything sharp from corner to corner, large-format documentary detail, dusty ochre, khaki and ash tones everywhere except the repeated hard blue rectangles of the pools. Calm, still and almost geometric, a composition that first reads as an abstract quilt of shapes and only then as two worlds divided. No text, no signs, no lettering, no logos anywhere. Thanks.
